requirements.title: Pre-File-Work Process Automation
requirements.definition: Automate the TaxDome workflow so that human involvement is minimized until staff must begin working on the client's file.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the automation and human-handoff objective; the requirement to consolidate existing pipelines into one end-to-end pipeline is a separately changeable workflow-structure decision.

requirements.title: Single End-to-End TaxDome Pipeline
requirements.definition: Represent the work previously associated with pipelines 1 and 2 in one end-to-end TaxDome pipeline.
requirements.boundary_note: Pipeline consolidation is independently changeable from the degree of automation and human involvement, so it remains a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Tiered Service Package Configuration
requirements.definition: Configure tier-based service packages using the client's supplied pricing and service-tier information.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the general tiered-package mechanism; the Nil Corporate flat-price exception is independently specified and excluded from the tiers.

requirements.title: Nil Corporate Upfront Pricing
requirements.definition: Handle Nil Corporate returns as a $150 upfront payment without service tiers or deposits.
requirements.boundary_note: The upfront amount, absence of tiers, and absence of deposits form one tightly coupled pricing exception for Nil Corporate returns.

unresolved_candidates.description: The supplied evidence establishes that pipelines 1 and 2 must be consolidated, but it does not describe the individual behaviors previously contained in those pipelines.

The referenced pricing/service-tier document and the meaning and required behavior of the tiered package ELs are not supplied, so additional tier rules or independently required artifacts cannot be resolved safely.
